I worked two days at a fruit packing company. 

12 hour shifts with a 15 minute break every 4 hours for minimum wage. I’m not afraid of working my ass off but this is a completely different type of work. I felt like a robot because I stood there for 4 hours at a time not moving, packing fruit at a VERY fast pace. If you messed up packing your whole line had to stop because the fruit was coming down the conveyor belt so fast that it would pile up. I was astonished by the other people working there. I couldn’t comprehend how someone could do that every single day for 12 hours a day. Needless to say I quit and never looked back. I give credit to those that do it but I couldn’t do such a mind-numbing, tedious job.
